'''Rish Loo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Minister]] who presided on [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] and served the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]]. He secretly conspired with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], but his dealings with the Sith ultimately cost him his life.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Master, I have done what yousa asked. Skywalker isa here."<br />"Young Master Skywalker. You're nothing if not relentless. What a surprise... You're a fool, Rish Loo.|Rish Loo and Dooku, before the latter kills the former|<ref name="Shadow Warrior" />}}
Rish Loo was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Otolla/Legends|Otolla]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Priest/Legends|priest]] who served as an advisor to [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] of the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Gungan High Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. However, it was revealed that Rish Loo was serving as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was able to control Lyonie with an [[amulet of influence]] in order to force the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to turn against [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

The plan was a failure when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] discovered that Lyonie was under the influence of the necklace. They then confronted Rish, this led to him stabbing Lyonie, buying him time to escape [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] for the surface, where the invasion forces awaited and were to meet with Separatist forces. Attempting to take control of the Gungan Grand Army by spreading misinformation regarding Lyonie's apparent death, Loo failed when Binks, disguised as Lyonie, arrived and deemed Rish Loo to be a traitor. Once more escaping aboard a speeder, he eluded the pursuing Skywalker, while simultaneously leading him into a trap.

[[File:Rish_Loo_death.png|thumb|left|Rish Loo's death at the hand of Count Dooku.]]

Loo eventually arrived at his [[Rish Loo's laboratory/Legends|secret lair]] to meet with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] immediately [[Death/Legends|killed]] him for his incompetence, before turning his attentions to Anakin, who'd followed Loo all the way to the lair.

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, Rish Loo was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who voiced Count Dooku and a Gungan soldier in the same episode.

Rish Loo's name has been noted for its similarity to that of [[Wikipedia: Cardinal Richelieu|Cardinal Richelieu]] from [[Wikipedia:The Three Musketeers|''The Three Musketeers'']].<ref name="SWWEG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep404|text="Shadow Warrior" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
